bench_setup = function() {
	set.seed(20261117)
	n = 200L
	w = rbinom(n, 1, 0.5); x1 = rnorm(n); x2 = rnorm(n)
	X = cbind("(Intercept)" = 1, treatment = w, x1 = x1, x2 = x2)
	mu = stats::plogis(-0.2 + 0.4 * w + 0.3 * x1 - 0.2 * x2)
	y = stats::rbeta(n, mu * 10, (1 - mu) * 10)
	u = runif(n)
	y[u < 0.08] = 0
	y[u > 0.95] = 1
	row_weights = stats::rexp(n)
	list(X = X, y = y, row_weights = row_weights)
}

bench_run = function(d) {
	X = d$X; y = d$y; row_weights = d$row_weights
	is_zero = as.numeric(y == 0); is_one = as.numeric(y == 1); is_mid = y > 0 & y < 1
	zero_fit = tryCatch(EDI:::fast_logistic_regression_weighted_cpp(X = X, y = is_zero, weights = row_weights), error = function(e) NULL)
	one_fit = tryCatch(EDI:::fast_logistic_regression_weighted_cpp(X = X, y = is_one, weights = row_weights), error = function(e) NULL)
	X_mid = X[is_mid, , drop = FALSE]
	y_mid = EDI:::sanitize_beta_response(y[is_mid])
	w_mid = row_weights[is_mid]
	df_mid = as.data.frame(X_mid[, -1, drop = FALSE])
	df_mid$y = y_mid
	beta_fit = suppressWarnings(betareg::betareg(y ~ ., data = df_mid, weights = w_mid,
		control = betareg::betareg.control(start = list(phi = 10))))
	as.numeric(stats::coef(beta_fit)[colnames(X_mid)])
}
